_comment: Copy this file to 'safety_terms.json' (repo root or inside a project folder). 'extra_terms' ADDS words to block (severity: high|medium|low). 'allow_terms' EXCLUDES words from the built-in blocklist — use it to fix false positives (e.g. a history channel saying 'منغولي').
allow_terms: كلمة مسموح بها رغم وجودها في القائمة المدمجة
